<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/user_settings"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns every configured user's profile info (name, display name,
email, SSH key, and roles). Passwords are never included.

Readable by any authenticated user so the Settings page can render, but
another user's SSH private key is a credential rather than a profile
field - it's withheld unless you hold 'Manage users' or it's your own.
